VBO:0201360.summary: Historical Toy Bulldogs were affectionate, devoted companions with a keen interest in people and their surroundings. Food could coax them into obedience, and rabbits could stir their sporting interest. Their English club maintained a small show variety, later called the Miniature Bulldog.
VBO:0201360.shortDescription: Affectionate and attentive, historical Toy Bulldogs combined close companionship with an interest in outdoor sport.
